title: Early farm: in the first 60 s, walk to cubes harder while keeping early spacing (EARLY_FARM_ON)
source: Mech Watcher ladder update 11:38 PM ET (PR #152 comment 7074455224): winners alive at 60 s had 4.2 vs 2.2 cubes, 1.9 vs 1.2 upgrades; kept ~145 m nearest-enemy spacing in the first 30 s
change: From 10 s to 60 s, when the champion has no farm goal: walk to the nearest zone-safe cube within 120 m (champion farm reach is 80 m) if every enemy in view or known in the last 10 s is more than 145 m away and no mech hit us for 3 s. The champion's farm gate requires no enemy in view at all. Drops, hunt, and every other mode are unchanged and keep priority.
distinct_from: B12/B13 (farm gate, no enemy in view), B21 (upgrade order), P23b (late idle farm)
coordinator_note: Near-miss data test 12:47 AM ET Sun by 10-minute loop. LOSS −0.21. PR closed.
decision: Near-miss data test submitted 12:47 AM ET by the 10-minute loop (one veto: drop-ring 8→3 on 2000+3000). Site 4.23 vs 4.44 (BB-0AB39656), LOSS (−0.21). PR closed. Findings N3: the drop-ring loss was real, and the sim early-death gain (48→45) did not carry over. Don't build on F11 as-is; F8 stays a ladder signal only.
next_action: None. Do not repeat this early-farm-with-enemies-in-view mechanism as built.
hypothesis: In the first 60 s, walking to cubes harder while keeping early spacing should cut early deaths and raise early upgrades (findings F8; P52.json source: Watcher 11:38 PM ET, winners alive at 60 s had 4.2 vs 2.2 cubes and 1.9 vs 1.2 upgrades).
mechanism: EARLY_FARM_ON as specified in P52.json change. SHA 74b6ee4, PR #169.
activation: Mac screen: different behaviour 26 and 22 of 192.
positives: Mac screen only (did not transfer): died<40 s 48→45 and 38→37; means +0.047 and +0.016 (F11).
